note: The real number of servers of Petto for each day, as measured by the public tracker discord.watch (a third party count of the bot, not made by Petto), fetched on 2026-11-04 from its chart endpoint with span=all. `values[i]` is the count of the day `start` plus i steps (`start` is 2026-07-28, 00:00 UTC; the label of the day is kept as the tracker gives it); `null` is a day the tracker has no data for (it draws it dashed). The numbers are exactly as received. They are only used for the days before the first snapshot the bot stored itself: a day with a number is that number; a day with `null` is a straight line between the nearest known days on both sides and is flagged `estimatedServers`. Nothing is shown before `start`, and today is always the live count of the bot, which can differ a little from the tracker.
